cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

mechanism: A treats its pupil fallback to wiring as an obsolete lesson, requiring practical negotiation with a sentient house after a specific response.
confusable: Not merely suggesting the strange account alongside repair: A explicitly demands abandoning the electrician and planning only through house consent.
comparison: Ordinary repair surrendered after response versus physical searching surrendered to key emotions.
